label: PREDICTED: whole-field oblique clean windows, 3D cell model (src/cell3d.py, side walls + pentagon roof, the live solver's default) with literature aero (research/params_lit.json, ASSUMED, not POLLEN measurements) at rho 1.2041 kg/m^3 (derived, still air). Window = clean air-only entry, not a hit probability; no repeatability claim.

provenance.cell_model: PREDICTED geometry model: 3D cell of src/cell3d.py from the CONFIRMED tilt-30 section (PM-019; before PM-019 this export used the section model with s_eff)
provenance.rho: derived 1.2041 kg/m^3 (src/air.py STILL_AIR_RHO; was 1.20 before PM-019)

provenance.other_hive_footprint: derived box, ASSUMED as blocking (straight sight line, no flight height)
provenance.robot_footprint: 18 x 18 in CONFIRMED (R102); release at the chassis centre ASSUMED; any heading
provenance.tilt_bounds_now: derived 28.80-31.77 deg (wide 25.90-34.83), data/hive_geometry.json; this export is tilt 30 only

frame.x: field x = shot axis: distance from the HIVE pivot plane (x = 0); d = |x|
frame.y: along the pivot axis; up-cell aim point at y = 0 (red HIVE centre); the other alliance HIVE plan box (grown by R) is |x| < 0.6745, y 0.3455-0.9495; field inner wall |x| = 1.8009, y in [-1.4773, 2.1245]
frame.far_side: unfav (far / unfavourable): x < 0 for pose_pos; gate centre is d + 0.401 m away horizontally
frame.near_side: fav (near / favourable): x > 0 for pose_pos, mouth faces the shooter; gate centre d - 0.401 m away horizontally
frame.pose: pose_pos (red up cell on +x). For pose_neg mirror x -> -x; for the blue HIVE also mirror y (y -> 0.6472 - y). The mouth (favourable) and back (unfavourable) sides swap each time the HIVE tips.
frame.hives: both HIVEs hang from one A-frame at the field centre, centre-to-centre 0.6472 m (CAD); A-frame base |x| < 0.494665, y in [-0.304542, 0.951742] (38.95 x 49.46 in, CONFIRMED)
frame.psi: psi = atan(|y| / Lh), Lh = d + 0.401 (far) or max(d - 0.401, 1e-3) (near); symmetric in sign(y)

grid.psi_side_wall_how: PREDICTED straight-line estimate: atan((0.254 - 0.0355) / 0.30556) with cell half-width 0.254, ball radius 0.0355, cell depth 0.30556 (all CONFIRMED/derived, hive_geometry.json); ball enters on the centre line, no lateral roof profile; near-side estimate; far side not checked (it depends on entry angle and height, 32-82 deg, research/GEOMETRY_AUDIT.md fix 6). The masks in this export (PM-019) and the live solver (solver.js, default sideWalls) model the side walls in 3D (PM-013), so this estimate is informational only (FIELD_DATA.md, 3D cell model)
grid.order: mask file = u32 n | u32 off[nPsi*nH+1] | u32 idx[n] | u16 margin[n] | u16 ang[n]; slice (ip*nH+ih) = entries off[s]..off[s+1]; idx = id*nV*nTh + iv*nTh + ith (sorted)
grid.coarsened: v/theta steps: far 0.05/0.2 (page 2D grid 0.05/0.1); near 0.1/0.5; d step 0.05; psi step 5 deg
